model User {

  email        String   @unique

  @@index([cpf])
  @@index([whatsapp])
}

model ServiceOrder {

  osNumber Int    @unique

  expectedDeliveryDate DateTime?

  historicos           HistoricoOrdem[]
  attachments          ServiceOrderAttachment[]
  internalNotes        ServiceOrderInternalNote[]
  payments             ServiceOrderPayment[]
  technicalParts       ServiceOrderPart[]
  technicalCommandLogs ServiceOrderTechnicalCommandLog[]

  customerId String
  customer   Customer @relation(fields: [customerId], references: [id])

  createdById String?
  createdBy   User?   @relation(fields: [createdById], references: [id])

  equipmentType  EquipmentType

  laborCost   Decimal @default(0)
  discount    Decimal @default(0)
  totalAmount Decimal @default(0)

  paymentMethod PaymentMethod @default(AGUARDANDO_PAGAMENTO)
  status        OrderStatus   @default(RECEBIDO)

  finalizedAt DateTime?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  finalization OrderFinalization?
  histories    OrderHistory[]

  paidAmount        Decimal   @default(0)
  paymentPercent    Int       @default(0)
  paymentReceivedAt DateTime?

  @@index([osNumber])

  @@index([model])
  @@index([imei])
  @@index([serialNumber])
  @@index([status])
  @@index([technicianUserId])

  newValue    String?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([serviceOrderId])
}

model HistoricoOrdem {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  ordemId   String

  @@index([ordemId])
}

model ServiceOrderAttachment {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  serviceOrderId String
  fileName       String
  originalName   String
  url            String
  mimeType       String?
  size           Int?
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  serviceOrder ServiceOrder @relation(fields: [serviceOrderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([serviceOrderId])
}

model ServiceOrderInternalNote {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  serviceOrderId String
  userName       String   @default("Sistema")
  note           String

  serviceOrder ServiceOrder @relation(fields: [serviceOrderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([serviceOrderId])
}

model ServiceOrderPayment {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  serviceOrderId String
  amount         Decimal
  percent        Int
  paymentMethod  String
  note           String?
  userName       String   @default("Sistema")
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  serviceOrder ServiceOrder @relation(fields: [serviceOrderId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([serviceOrderId])
}

model SystemUser {
  id String @id @default(cuid())

  name         String
  username     String  @unique
  email        String?
  passwordHash String

  role   SystemUserRole   @default(ATENDENTE)
  status SystemUserStatus @default(ATIVO)

  "reservedBefore" INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK ("reservedBefore" >= 0 AND ("onHandBefore" IS NULL OR "reservedBefore" <= "onHandBefore")),
  "reservedAfter" INTEGER NOT NULL
    CHECK ("reservedAfter" >= 0 AND ("onHandAfter" IS NULL OR "reservedAfter" <= "onHandAfter")),
  "unitCostSnapshot" DECIMAL CHECK ("unitCostSnapshot" IS NULL OR "unitCostSnapshot" >= 0),
  "reason" TEXT,
  "operatorId" TEXT,
  "operatorNameSnapshot" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim("operatorNameSnapshot")) > 0),
  "idempotencyKey" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,

    ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,

    ("type" IN ('POSITIVE_ADJUSTMENT', 'NEGATIVE_ADJUSTMENT', 'MANUAL_REVERSAL', 'STOCK_MODE_CHANGE')
      AND length(trim(coalesce("reason", ''))) > 0)
    OR "type" NOT IN ('POSITIVE_ADJUSTMENT', 'NEGATIVE_ADJUSTMENT', 'MANUAL_REVERSAL', 'STOCK_MODE_CHANGE')
  ),
  CHECK (
    ("type" IN ('ENTRY', 'POSITIVE_ADJUSTMENT')
      AND "onHandBefore" IS NOT NULL
      AND "onHandAfter" = "onHandBefore" + "quantity"
      AND "reservedAfter" = "reservedBefore") OR
    ("type" = 'NEGATIVE_ADJUSTMENT'
      AND "onHandBefore" IS NOT NULL
      AND "onHandAfter" = "onHandBefore" - "quantity"
      AND "reservedAfter" = "reservedBefore") OR
    ("type" IN ('RESERVATION', 'RESERVATION_INCREASE')
      AND "onHandAfter" IS "onHandBefore"
      AND "reservedAfter" = "reservedBefore" + "quantity") OR
    ("type" IN ('RESERVATION_DECREASE', 'RELEASE')
      AND "onHandAfter" IS "onHandBefore"
      AND "reservedAfter" = "reservedBefore" - "quantity") OR
    ("type" = 'CONSUMPTION'
      AND (("onHandBefore" IS NULL AND "onHandAfter" IS NULL) OR "onHandAfter" = "onHandBefore" - "quantity")
      AND "reservedAfter" = "reservedBefore" - "quantity") OR
    ("type" = 'MANUAL_REVERSAL'
      AND (("onHandBefore" IS NULL AND "onHandAfter" IS NULL) OR "onHandAfter" = "onHandBefore" + "quantity")
      AND "reservedAfter" = "reservedBefore") OR
    ("type" = 'STOCK_MODE_CHANGE'
      AND "reservedBefore" = 0 AND "reservedAfter" = 0
      AND (("onHandBefore" IS NULL AND "onHandAfter" IS NOT NULL AND "onHandAfter" = "quantity")
        OR ("onHandBefore" IS NOT NULL AND "onHandAfter" IS NULL)))
  )
);

function normalizeSql(sql) {
  return String(sql)
    .replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n")
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) => line.trimEnd())
    .join("\n")
    .trim();
}

function canonicalize(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(canonicalize);
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(value)
        .sort()
        .map((key) => [key, canonicalize(value[key])])
    );
  }
  return value;
}

function checksumPayload(migration) {
  return {
    alteredTables: migration.alteredTables || [],
    appVersion: migration.appVersion,
    id: migration.id,
    ownedTables: migration.ownedTables || [],
    requiresForeignKeysOff: Boolean(migration.requiresForeignKeysOff),
    requiredTables: migration.requiredTables || [],
    schemaChecks: migration.schemaChecks || {},
    structureChecks: migration.structureChecks || {},
    sql: normalizeSql(migration.sql),
  };
}

function migrationChecksum(migration) {
  return crypto
    .createHash("sha256")
    .update(JSON.stringify(canonicalize(checksumPayload(migration))), "utf8")
    .digest("hex");
}

function defineMigration(definition) {
  const migration = {
    ...definition,
    sql: normalizeSql(definition.sql),
    ownedTables: Object.freeze([...(definition.ownedTables || [])]),
    alteredTables: Object.freeze([...(definition.alteredTables || [])]),
    requiredTables: Object.freeze([...(definition.requiredTables || [])]),
    schemaChecks: Object.freeze({ ...(definition.schemaChecks || {}) }),
    structureChecks: Object.freeze({ ...(definition.structureChecks || {}) }),
    requiresForeignKeysOff: Boolean(definition.requiresForeignKeysOff),
  };
  migration.checksum = migrationChecksum(migration);
  return Object.freeze(migration);
}

function nullableString(value: unknown): string | null {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? null : String(value);
}

export function findTechnicalServiceOrder(
  database: StockDatabase,
  serviceOrderId: string,
): TechnicalServiceOrderRecord | null {
  const row = database.prepare(`SELECT
    o."id", o."status", o."partsCost", o."laborCost", o."discount", o."totalAmount",
    o."paidAmount", o."paymentPercent", o."paymentReceivedAt", o."finalizedAt",
    o."requiredParts", o."technicianResponsible", o."technicianUserId",
    o."technicianProfitPercentSnapshot",
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "OrderFinalization" f WHERE f."serviceOrderId" = o."id") AS "hasFinalization",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ServiceOrderPayment" p WHERE p."serviceOrderId" = o."id") AS "paymentCount"
    FROM "ServiceOrder" o WHERE o."id" = ?`).get(serviceOrderId);
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    status: String(row.status),
    partsCost: Number(row.partsCost),
    laborCost: Number(row.laborCost),
    discount: Number(row.discount),
    totalAmount: Number(row.totalAmount),
    technicianResponsible: nullableString(row.technicianResponsible),
    technicianUserId: nullableString(row.technicianUserId),
    technicianProfitPercentSnapshot:
      row.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot === null || row.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot === undefined
        ? null
        : Number(row.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot),
    paidAmount: Number(row.paidAmount),
    paymentPercent: Number(row.paymentPercent),
    paymentReceivedAt: nullableString(row.paymentReceivedAt),
    finalizedAt: nullableString(row.finalizedAt),
    requiredParts: nullableString(row.requiredParts),
    hasFinalization: Boolean(row.hasFinalization),
    paymentCount: Number(row.paymentCount),
  };
}



export function findActiveTechnicianForReady(
  database: StockDatabase,
  technicianUserId: string,
): ProfitShareTechnicianRecord | null {
  const row = database.prepare(`SELECT
    "id", "name", "profitShareEnabled", "profitSharePercent"
    FROM "SystemUser"
    WHERE "id" = ? AND "role" = 'TECNICO' AND "status" = 'ATIVO'`)
    .get(technicianUserId);

  if (!row) return null;

  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    name: String(row.name),
    profitShareEnabled: Boolean(row.profitShareEnabled),
    profitSharePercent: Number(row.profitSharePercent),
  };
}

export function markTechnicalServiceOrderReady(
  database: StockDatabase,
  input: {
    id: string;
    expectedStatus: string;
    technicianResponsible: string;
    technicianUserId: string | null;
    technicianProfitPercentSnapshot: number | null;
  },
): number {
  return Number(database.prepare(`UPDATE "ServiceOrder" SET
    "status" = 'PRONTO',
    "technicianResponsible" = ?,
    "technicianUserId" = ?,
    "technicianProfitPercentSnapshot" = ?,
    "updatedAt" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE "id" = ? AND "status" = ?
      AND "status" IN ('RECEBIDO', 'EM_ANALISE', 'AGUARDANDO_PECA', 'EM_REPARO')
      AND "finalizedAt" IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "OrderFinalization" f WHERE f."serviceOrderId" = "ServiceOrder"."id")`)
    .run(
      input.technicianResponsible,
      input.technicianUserId,
      input.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot,
      input.id,
      input.expectedStatus,
    ).changes);
}

export function markTechnicalServiceOrderCancelled(
  database: StockDatabase,
  input: { id: string; expectedStatus: string },
): number {
  return Number(database.prepare(`UPDATE "ServiceOrder" SET
    "status" = 'CANCELADO', "updatedAt" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    WHERE "id" = ? AND "status" = ?
      AND "status" NOT IN ('CANCELADO', 'ENTREGUE')
      AND "finalizedAt" IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "OrderFinalization" f WHERE f."serviceOrderId" = "ServiceOrder"."id")`)
    .run(input.id, input.expectedStatus).changes);
}

", "lib/estoqueTecnico/orderConsumptionService.ts": "import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { validateCommandContext } from "./commands";
import { __withImmediateTransactionForTests, withImmediateTransaction } from "./db";
import { stockError, validationError } from "./errors";
import { buildPersistedIdempotencyKey, hashIdempotentPayload } from "./idempotency";
import {
  findConsumptionMovementForItem,
  insertTechnicalPartMovement,
  countConsumptionMovementsForItem,
  listConsumptionMovementsForCommand,
} from "./movementRepository";
import {
  consumeReservedOrderPart,
  findOrderPartById,
  listReservedOrderParts,
} from "./orderPartRepository";
import {
  findActiveTechnicianForReady,
  findTechnicalServiceOrder,
  insertReadyStatusHistory,
  insertTechnicalConsumptionHistory,
  markTechnicalServiceOrderReady,
} from "./orderRepository";
import {
  findServiceOrderTechnicalCommand,
  insertServiceOrderTechnicalCommand,
} from "./orderTechnicalCommandRepository";
import {
  consumeTechnicalPartReservation,
  findTechnicalPartById,
} from "./partRepository";
import { recalculateTechnicalPartsOrderTotals } from "./recalculateOrder";
import { sanitizeServiceOrderPart, sanitizeTechnicalPartMovement } from "./sanitize";
import type {
  ConsumeReadyResult,
  InternalCommandContext,
  ServiceOrderPartRecord,
  StockDatabase,
  TechnicalPartMovementRecord,
  TechnicalPartRecord,
  TechnicalServiceOrderRecord,
  TransactionResult,
} from "./types";
import {
  STOCK_NUMERIC_LIMITS,
  STOCK_TEXT_LIMITS,
  assertAllowedKeys,
  assertTechnicalMovementInvariant,
  requireBoolean,
  requireNonEmptyString,
  requirePlainRecord,
  requirePositiveInteger,
} from "./validation";

type TestLocation = { runtimeRoot: string; databasePath: string };
type FailurePoint =
  | "after_first_part"
  | "after_first_item"
  | "after_first_movement"
  | "after_all_items"
  | "after_status"
  | "after_history"
  | "before_command_log";
type WriteRunner = <T>(operation: string, callback: (database: StockDatabase) => T) => TransactionResult<T>;

type ReadyCommand = {
  expectedCurrentStatus: "RECEBIDO" | "EM_ANALISE" | "AGUARDANDO_PECA" | "EM_REPARO";
  confirmation: true;
  technicianResponsible?: string;
  technicianUserId?: string;
};

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<ReadyCommand["expectedCurrentStatus"], string> = {
  RECEBIDO: "Recebido",
  EM_ANALISE: "Em análise",
  AGUARDANDO_PECA: "Aguardando peça",
  EM_REPARO: "Em reparo",
};

function validateReadyCommand(value: unknown): ReadyCommand {
  const input = requirePlainRecord(value);
  assertAllowedKeys(input, [
    "expectedCurrentStatus",
    "confirmation",
    "technicianResponsible",
    "technicianUserId",
  ]);
  const status = requireNonEmptyString(input.expectedCurrentStatus, "expectedCurrentStatus", 40);
  if (!(status in STATUS_LABELS)) {
    throw validationError("O status atual esperado é inválido.", { field: "expectedCurrentStatus" });
  }
  if (requireBoolean(input.confirmation, "confirmation") !== true) {
    throw validationError("Confirme a conclusão do reparo.", { field: "confirmation" });
  }

  const hasTechnicianUserId = input.technicianUserId !== undefined;
  const hasLegacyTechnician = input.technicianResponsible !== undefined;
  if (hasTechnicianUserId === hasLegacyTechnician) {
    throw validationError(
      "Informe exatamente um técnico responsável.",
      { field: "technicianUserId" },
    );
  }

  return {
    expectedCurrentStatus: status as ReadyCommand["expectedCurrentStatus"],
    confirmation: true,
    ...(hasTechnicianUserId
      ? {
          technicianUserId: requireNonEmptyString(
            input.technicianUserId,
            "technicianUserId",
            STOCK_TEXT_LIMITS.ID,
          ),
        }
      : {
          technicianResponsible: requireNonEmptyString(
            input.technicianResponsible,
            "technicianResponsible",
            120,
          ),
        }),
  };
}

function stableScope(value: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex").slice(0, 32);
}

function operatorScope(context: InternalCommandContext): string {
  return context.operatorId ? `user_${stableScope(context.operatorId)}` : "system";
}

function commandLogicalKey(
  orderId: string,
  context: InternalCommandContext,
): string {
  return buildPersistedIdempotencyKey({
    namespace: "so",
    operation: "consume-ready",
    version: "v1",
    resources: [operatorScope(context), stableScope(orderId)],
    requestKey: context.idempotencyKey,
  });
}

function movementKey(
  orderId: string,
  itemId: string,
  context: InternalCommandContext,
  payloadHash: string,
): string {
  return `${buildPersistedIdempotencyKey({
    namespace: "sop",
    operation: "consume",
    version: "v1",
    resources: [operatorScope(context), stableScope(orderId), stableScope(itemId)],
    requestKey: context.idempotencyKey,
  })}:${payloadHash}`;
}

function movementCommandPattern(
  orderId: string,
  context: InternalCommandContext,
  payloadHash: string,
): string {
  const escapeLike = (value: string) =>
    value.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/%/g, "\\%").replace(/_/g, "\\_");
  // Movimento: sop:consume:v1:{operator}:{order}:{item}:{requestKey}:{hash}.
  // O item varia entre os movimentos do mesmo comando; a chave externa e o
  // hash permanecem fixos e são delimitados para não aceitar outro comando.
  const commandPrefix = [
    "sop",
    "consume",
    "v1",
    operatorScope(context),
    stableScope(orderId),
  ].join(":");
  return `${escapeLike(commandPrefix)}:%:${escapeLike(context.idempotencyKey)}:${escapeLike(payloadHash)}`;
}

function requireOrder(database: StockDatabase, id: string): TechnicalServiceOrderRecord {
  const order = findTechnicalServiceOrder(database, id);
  if (!order) throw stockError("SERVICE_ORDER_NOT_FOUND", 404, "A ordem de serviço não foi encontrada.");
  return order;
}

function project(
  order: TechnicalServiceOrderRecord,
  items: ServiceOrderPartRecord[],
  movements: TechnicalPartMovementRecord[],
  context: InternalCommandContext,
  replay: boolean,
): ConsumeReadyResult {
  return {
    order: {
      id: order.id,
      status: order.status,
      technicianResponsible: order.technicianResponsible,
      technicianUserId: order.technicianUserId,
      ...(context.canViewFinancialData
        ? { technicianProfitPercentSnapshot: order.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot }
        : {}),
      partsCost: order.partsCost,
      laborCost: order.laborCost,
      discount: order.discount,
      totalAmount: order.totalAmount,
    },
    consumedItems: items.map((item) => sanitizeServiceOrderPart(item, context.canViewFinancialData)),
    movements: movements.map((movement) => sanitizeTechnicalPartMovement(movement, context.canViewFinancialData)),
    affectedItems: items.length,
    affectedUnits: items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0),
    idempotentReplay: replay,
  };
}

function invariant(message: string): never {
  throw stockError("STOCK_INVARIANT_VIOLATION", 409, message);
}

function validatePair(item: ServiceOrderPartRecord, part: TechnicalPartRecord | null): TechnicalPartRecord {
  if (!part) throw stockError("TECHNICAL_PART_NOT_FOUND", 404, "A peça técnica não foi encontrada.");
  if (item.technicalPartId !== part.id) invariant("O vínculo do item técnico está inconsistente.");
  try {
    requirePositiveInteger(item.quantity, "quantity");
  } catch {
    invariant("A quantidade do item técnico está inconsistente.");
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(part.version) || part.version >= STOCK_NUMERIC_LIMITS.MAX_VERSION) {
    invariant("A versão da peça técnica está inconsistente.");
  }
  if (part.quantityReserved < item.quantity) invariant("O saldo reservado está inconsistente.");
  if (part.quantityOnHand !== null && part.quantityOnHand < item.quantity) {
    invariant("O saldo físico está inconsistente.");
  }
  return part;
}

function makeServices(write: WriteRunner, failAfter?: FailurePoint) {
  function markServiceOrderReadyAndConsumeTechnicalParts(
    serviceOrderIdValue: unknown,
    inputValue: unknown,
    contextValue: unknown,
  ): ConsumeReadyResult {
    const serviceOrderId = requireNonEmptyString(serviceOrderIdValue, "serviceOrderId", STOCK_TEXT_LIMITS.ID);
    const input = validateReadyCommand(inputValue);
    const context = validateCommandContext(contextValue);
    const logicalKey = commandLogicalKey(serviceOrderId, context);
    const payloadHash = hashIdempotentPayload(input);

    return write("service-order-ready-consume", (database) => {
      const priorCommand = findServiceOrderTechnicalCommand(database, logicalKey);
      if (priorCommand) {
        if (
          priorCommand.operation !== "CONSUME_ON_READY" ||
          priorCommand.serviceOrderId !== serviceOrderId ||
          priorCommand.payloadHash !== payloadHash
        ) {
          throw stockError("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED", 409, "A chave de idempotência já foi usada com dados diferentes.");
        }
        const replayMovements = listConsumptionMovementsForCommand(database, {
          serviceOrderId,
          movementPattern: movementCommandPattern(serviceOrderId, context, payloadHash),
        });
        const replayItems: ServiceOrderPartRecord[] = [];
        const itemIds = new Set<string>();
        for (const movement of replayMovements) {
          if (!movement.serviceOrderPartId || itemIds.has(movement.serviceOrderPartId)) {
            invariant("O histórico do consumo técnico está inconsistente.");
          }
          const item = findOrderPartById(database, movement.serviceOrderPartId);
          if (!item || item.serviceOrderId !== serviceOrderId) {
            invariant("O vínculo do consumo técnico está inconsistente.");
          }
          if (item.state !== "CONSUMED" && item.state !== "REVERSED") {
            invariant("O estado atual do item técnico está inconsistente.");
          }
          if (
            movement.type !== "CONSUMPTION" ||
            movement.technicalPartId !== item.technicalPartId ||
            movement.quantity !== item.quantity ||
            movement.idempotencyKey !== movementKey(serviceOrderId, item.id, context, payloadHash)
          ) {
            invariant("O histórico do consumo técnico está inconsistente.");
          }
          if (countConsumptionMovementsForItem(database, item.id) !== 1) {
            invariant("Existem múltiplos movimentos de consumo para o item técnico.");
          }
          itemIds.add(item.id);
          replayItems.push(item);
        }
        if (replayItems.length !== priorCommand.affectedItems) {
          invariant("A auditoria do consumo técnico está inconsistente.");
        }
        return project(requireOrder(database, serviceOrderId), replayItems, replayMovements, context, true);
      }

      const order = requireOrder(database, serviceOrderId);
      if (order.status !== input.expectedCurrentStatus) {
        throw stockError("ORDER_STATUS_CONFLICT", 409, "A ordem de serviço foi alterada por outra operação.");
      }
      if (order.hasFinalization || order.finalizedAt !== null) {
        throw stockError("ORDER_NOT_MUTABLE", 409, "Esta ordem de serviço não pode ser marcada como pronta.");
      }



      let technicianResponsible: string;
      let technicianUserId: string | null = null;
      let technicianProfitPercentSnapshot: number | null = null;

      if (input.technicianUserId) {
        const technician = findActiveTechnicianForReady(database, input.technicianUserId);
        if (!technician) {
          throw validationError(
            "Selecione um técnico ativo cadastrado no sistema.",
            { field: "technicianUserId" },
          );
        }
        if (!technician.name.trim()) {
          invariant("O cadastro do técnico está inconsistente.");
        }
        if (
          !Number.isFinite(technician.profitSharePercent) ||
          technician.profitSharePercent < 0 ||
          technician.profitSharePercent > 100
        ) {
          invariant("O percentual de participação do técnico está inconsistente.");
        }

        technicianResponsible = technician.name.trim();
        technicianUserId = technician.id;
        technicianProfitPercentSnapshot = technician.profitShareEnabled
          ? Math.round((technician.profitSharePercent + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
          : 0;
      } else {
        technicianResponsible = input.technicianResponsible!;
      }

      const items = listReservedOrderParts(database, serviceOrderId);
      const pairs = items.map((item) => {
        if (findConsumptionMovementForItem(database, item.id)) {
          invariant("O item técnico já possui consumo registrado.");
        }
        return { item, part: validatePair(item, findTechnicalPartById(database, item.technicalPartId)) };
      });

      const movements: TechnicalPartMovementRecord[] = [];
      for (let index = 0; index < pairs.length; index += 1) {
        const { item, part } = pairs[index];
        if (consumeTechnicalPartReservation(database, {
          id: part.id,
          version: part.version,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unlimited: part.quantityOnHand === null,
        }) !== 1) invariant("Não foi possível consumir o saldo técnico.");
        if (index === 0 && failAfter === "after_first_part") throw new Error("laboratory failure");

        if (consumeReservedOrderPart(database, {
          id: item.id,
          serviceOrderId,
          technicalPartId: part.id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
        }) !== 1) invariant("Não foi possível consumir o item técnico.");
        if (index === 0 && failAfter === "after_first_item") throw new Error("laboratory failure");

        const after = findTechnicalPartById(database, part.id)!;
        assertTechnicalMovementInvariant({
          type: "CONSUMPTION",
          quantity: item.quantity,
          onHandBefore: part.quantityOnHand,
          onHandAfter: after.quantityOnHand,
          reservedBefore: part.quantityReserved,
          reservedAfter: after.quantityReserved,
        });
        const movement = insertTechnicalPartMovement(database, {
          technicalPartId: part.id,
          serviceOrderPartId: item.id,
          type: "CONSUMPTION",
          quantity: item.quantity,
          onHandBefore: part.quantityOnHand,
          onHandAfter: after.quantityOnHand,
          reservedBefore: part.quantityReserved,
          reservedAfter: after.quantityReserved,
          unitCostSnapshot: item.unitCostSnapshot,
          reason: "Consumo ao concluir reparo da ordem de serviço",
          operatorId: context.operatorId,
          operatorNameSnapshot: context.operatorName,
          idempotencyKey: movementKey(serviceOrderId, item.id, context, payloadHash),
        });
        movements.push(movement);
        if (index === 0 && failAfter === "after_first_movement") throw new Error("laboratory failure");
      }
      if (failAfter === "after_all_items") throw new Error("laboratory failure");

      if (markTechnicalServiceOrderReady(database, {
        id: serviceOrderId,
        expectedStatus: input.expectedCurrentStatus,
        technicianResponsible,
        technicianUserId,
        technicianProfitPercentSnapshot,
      }) !== 1) {
        const current = requireOrder(database, serviceOrderId);
        if (current.status !== input.expectedCurrentStatus) {
          throw stockError("ORDER_STATUS_CONFLICT", 409, "A ordem de serviço foi alterada por outra operação.");
        }
        throw stockError("ORDER_NOT_MUTABLE", 409, "Esta ordem de serviço não pode ser marcada como pronta.");
      }
      if (failAfter === "after_status") throw new Error("laboratory failure");

      recalculateTechnicalPartsOrderTotals(database, serviceOrderId);
      insertReadyStatusHistory(database, {
        serviceOrderId,
        userName: context.operatorName,
        previousStatusLabel: STATUS_LABELS[input.expectedCurrentStatus],
        technicianResponsible,
      });
      const affectedUnits = items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0);
      if (items.length > 0) {
        insertTechnicalConsumptionHistory(database, {
          serviceOrderId,
          userName: context.operatorName,
          affectedItems: items.length,
          affectedUnits,
        });
      }
      if (failAfter === "after_history") throw new Error("laboratory failure");
      if (failAfter === "before_command_log") throw new Error("laboratory failure");

      insertServiceOrderTechnicalCommand(database, {
        logicalKey,
        payloadHash,
        operation: "CONSUME_ON_READY",
        serviceOrderId,
        operatorId: context.operatorId,
        operatorNameSnapshot: context.operatorName,
        affectedItems: items.length,
        resultOrderStatus: "PRONTO",
      });
      return project(requireOrder(database, serviceOrderId), items.map((item) => ({
        ...item,
        state: "CONSUMED",
        consumedAt: findConsumptionMovementForItem(database, item.id)!.createdAt,
      })), movements, context, false);
    }).value;
  }

  return { markServiceOrderReadyAndConsumeTechnicalParts };
}

const productionServices = makeServices(
  (operation, callback) => withImmediateTransaction(operation, callback),
);

export const markServiceOrderReadyAndConsumeTechnicalParts =
  productionServices.markServiceOrderReadyAndConsumeTechnicalParts;

/** @internal Somente para bancos descartáveis de laboratório. */
export function __createOrderConsumptionServicesForTests(
  location: TestLocation,
  options?: { failAfter?: FailurePoint },
) {
  return makeServices(
    (operation, callback) => __withImmediateTransactionForTests(location, operation, callback),
    options?.failAfter,
  );
}
", "app/api/ordens/[id]/status/route.ts": "import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { OrderStatus } from "@prisma/client";
import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
import {
  exigirPermissaoApi,
  usuarioPodeVerDadosFinanceirosSensiveis,
  usuarioTemPermissao,
} from "@/lib/permissaoApi";
import { requireIdempotencyKey } from "@/lib/estoqueTecnico/validation";
import {
  markServiceOrderReadyAndConsumeTechnicalParts,
} from "@/lib/estoqueTecnico";
import { toFutureHttpError } from "@/lib/estoqueTecnico/errors";

export const runtime = "nodejs";
export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type RouteContext = {
  params: Promise<{
    id: string;
  }>;
};

type UsuarioSessao = NonNullable<Parameters<typeof usuarioTemPermissao>[0]>;

const statusPermitidos: OrderStatus[] = [
  OrderStatus.RECEBIDO,
  OrderStatus.EM_ANALISE,
  OrderStatus.AGUARDANDO_PECA,
  OrderStatus.EM_REPARO,
  OrderStatus.PRONTO,
];

const nomesStatus: Record<string, string> = {
  RECEBIDO: "Recebido",
  EM_ANALISE: "Em análise",
  AGUARDANDO_PECA: "Aguardando peça",
  EM_REPARO: "Em reparo",
  PRONTO: "Pronto",
  ENTREGUE: "Entregue",
  CANCELADO: "Cancelado",
};

function nomeOperador(usuario: UsuarioSessao | null | undefined) {
  return usuario?.name?.trim() || usuario?.username?.trim() || "Sistema";
}

function textoLimitado(valor: unknown, limite: number) {
  return String(valor || "")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, limite);
}

function podeVerDadosPagamento(usuario: UsuarioSessao | null | undefined) {
  if (!usuario) return false;

  return usuarioTemPermissao(usuario, [
    "pagamentos.ver",
    "pagamentos.registrar",
    "relatorios.financeiro",
  ]);
}

function sanitizarOrdemStatus(
  ordem: any,
  mostrarPagamentos: boolean,
  mostrarFinanceiroSensivel: boolean,
) {
  const base = mostrarPagamentos
    ? ordem
    : {
        ...ordem,
        paidAmount: null,
        paymentPercent: null,
        paymentReceivedAt: null,
        paymentMethod: null,
        payments: [],
        finalization: ordem.finalization
          ? {
              ...ordem.finalization,
              finalAmount: null,
              paymentMethod: null,
            }
          : null,
      };

  if (mostrarFinanceiroSensivel) return base;

  return {
    ...base,
    technicianProfitPercentSnapshot: null,
  };
}

function respostaErroEstoque(error: unknown) {
  const mapped = toFutureHttpError(error);
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" };
  if (mapped.body.retryable) headers["Retry-After"] = "1";
  return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status, headers });
}

function validarComandoPronto(body: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const permitidos = new Set([
    "status",
    "expectedCurrentStatus",
    "confirmation",
    "technicianResponsible",
  ]);
  if (Object.keys(body).some((key) => !permitidos.has(key))) {
    return "O payload contém campos não permitidos para concluir a OS.";
  }
  if (body.status !== OrderStatus.PRONTO) return "O status de destino deve ser PRONTO.";
  const statusesOrigem: string[] = [
    OrderStatus.RECEBIDO,
    OrderStatus.EM_ANALISE,
    OrderStatus.AGUARDANDO_PECA,
    OrderStatus.EM_REPARO,
  ];
  if (
    typeof body.expectedCurrentStatus !== "string" ||
    !statusesOrigem.includes(body.expectedCurrentStatus)
  ) {
    return "Informe o status atual esperado da OS.";
  }
  if (body.confirmation !== true) return "Confirme a conclusão do reparo.";
  if (
    typeof body.technicianResponsible !== "string" ||
    !body.technicianResponsible.trim() ||
    body.technicianResponsible.trim().length > 120
  ) {
    return "Informe o técnico responsável pelo serviço.";
  }
  return null;
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request, context: RouteContext) {
  try {
    const body = (await request.json().catch(() => null)) as Record<
      string,
      unknown
    > | null;

      return NextResponse.json(

        idempotencyKey = requireIdempotencyKey(request.headers.get("Idempotency-Key"));

        const mapped = toFutureHttpError(error);

          { ...mapped.body, code: mapped.body.code },
          { status: 422, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
        );

        const result = markServiceOrderReadyAndConsumeTechnicalParts(
          id,
          {

            confirmation: true,
            technicianResponsible: String(body.technicianResponsible).trim(),

          {

      return NextResponse.json(
        {

    if (novoStatus === OrderStatus.PRONTO && !technicianResponsible) {

      );

        { status: 404 }

        { status: 400 }
      );

        { status: 400 }

            nomesStatus[novoStatus] || novoStatus

      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: novoStatus,

            action: "ALTERACAO_STATUS",
            description: descriptionStatus,

        customer: true,
        histories: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
        finalization: true,
        attachments: true,
        payments: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
      },
    });

      sanitizarOrdemStatus(
        ordemAtualizada,
        podeVerDadosPagamento(acesso.usuario),
        usuarioPodeVerDadosFinanceirosSensiveis(acesso.usuario),
      )
    );
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: "Erro ao alterar status da OS." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

  ),
  CHECK (
    ("type" IN ('ENTRY', 'POSITIVE_ADJUSTMENT')
      AND "onHandBefore" IS NOT NULL
      AND "onHandAfter" = "onHandBefore" + "quantity"
      AND "reservedAfter" = "reservedBefore") OR
    ("type" = 'NEGATIVE_ADJUSTMENT'

      AND "onHandAfter" = "onHandBefore" - "quantity"

    ("type" IN ('RESERVATION_DECREASE', 'RELEASE')
      AND "onHandAfter" IS "onHandBefore"
      AND "reservedAfter" = "reservedBefore" - "quantity") OR

function normalizeSql(sql) {
  return String(sql)
    .replace(/\r\n?/g, "\n")
    .split("\n")
    .map((line) => line.trimEnd())
    .join("\n")
    .trim();
}

function canonicalize(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(canonicalize);
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    return Object.fromEntries(
      Object.keys(value)
        .sort()
        .map((key) => [key, canonicalize(value[key])])
    );
  }
  return value;
}

function checksumPayload(migration) {
  return {
    alteredTables: migration.alteredTables || [],
    appVersion: migration.appVersion,
    id: migration.id,
    ownedTables: migration.ownedTables || [],
    requiresForeignKeysOff: Boolean(migration.requiresForeignKeysOff),
    requiredTables: migration.requiredTables || [],
    schemaChecks: migration.schemaChecks || {},
    structureChecks: migration.structureChecks || {},
    sql: normalizeSql(migration.sql),
  };
}

function migrationChecksum(migration) {
  return crypto
    .createHash("sha256")
    .update(JSON.stringify(canonicalize(checksumPayload(migration))), "utf8")
    .digest("hex");
}

function defineMigration(definition) {
  const migration = {
    ...definition,
    sql: normalizeSql(definition.sql),
    ownedTables: Object.freeze([...(definition.ownedTables || [])]),
    alteredTables: Object.freeze([...(definition.alteredTables || [])]),
    requiredTables: Object.freeze([...(definition.requiredTables || [])]),
    schemaChecks: Object.freeze({ ...(definition.schemaChecks || {}) }),
    structureChecks: Object.freeze({ ...(definition.structureChecks || {}) }),
    requiresForeignKeysOff: Boolean(definition.requiresForeignKeysOff),
  };
  migration.checksum = migrationChecksum(migration);
  return Object.freeze(migration);
}

export function findTechnicalServiceOrder(
  database: StockDatabase,
  serviceOrderId: string,

  const row = database.prepare(`SELECT
    o."id", o."status", o."partsCost", o."laborCost", o."discount", o."totalAmount",
    o."paidAmount", o."paymentPercent", o."paymentReceivedAt", o."finalizedAt",
    o."requiredParts", o."technicianResponsible", o."technicianUserId",
    o."technicianProfitPercentSnapshot",
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "OrderFinalization" f WHERE f."serviceOrderId" = o."id") AS "hasFinalization",
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ServiceOrderPayment" p WHERE p."serviceOrderId" = o."id") AS "paymentCount"
    FROM "ServiceOrder" o WHERE o."id" = ?`).get(serviceOrderId);
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: String(row.id),
    status: String(row.status),
    partsCost: Number(row.partsCost),
    laborCost: Number(row.laborCost),
    discount: Number(row.discount),
    totalAmount: Number(row.totalAmount),
    technicianResponsible: nullableString(row.technicianResponsible),
    technicianUserId: nullableString(row.technicianUserId),
    technicianProfitPercentSnapshot:
      row.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot === null || row.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot === undefined
        ? null
        : Number(row.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot),
    paidAmount: Number(row.paidAmount),
    paymentPercent: Number(row.paymentPercent),
    paymentReceivedAt: nullableString(row.paymentReceivedAt),
    finalizedAt: nullableString(row.finalizedAt),
    requiredParts: nullableString(row.requiredParts),
    hasFinalization: Boolean(row.hasFinalization),
    paymentCount: Number(row.paymentCount),
  };
}

} from "./types";

  STOCK_NUMERIC_LIMITS,
  STOCK_TEXT_LIMITS,
  assertAllowedKeys,
  assertTechnicalMovementInvariant,
  requireBoolean,
  requireNonEmptyString,
  requirePlainRecord,
  requirePositiveInteger,
} from "./validation";

type TestLocation = { runtimeRoot: string; databasePath: string };
type FailurePoint =
  | "after_first_part"
  | "after_first_item"
  | "after_first_movement"
  | "after_all_items"
  | "after_status"
  | "after_history"
  | "before_command_log";
type WriteRunner = <T>(operation: string, callback: (database: StockDatabase) => T) => TransactionResult<T>;

type ReadyCommand = {
  expectedCurrentStatus: "RECEBIDO" | "EM_ANALISE" | "AGUARDANDO_PECA" | "EM_REPARO";
  confirmation: true;
  technicianResponsible?: string;
  technicianUserId?: string;
};

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<ReadyCommand["expectedCurrentStatus"], string> = {
  RECEBIDO: "Recebido",
  EM_ANALISE: "Em análise",
  AGUARDANDO_PECA: "Aguardando peça",
  EM_REPARO: "Em reparo",
};

function validateReadyCommand(value: unknown): ReadyCommand {
  const input = requirePlainRecord(value);
  assertAllowedKeys(input, [
    "expectedCurrentStatus",
    "confirmation",
    "technicianResponsible",
    "technicianUserId",
  ]);
  const status = requireNonEmptyString(input.expectedCurrentStatus, "expectedCurrentStatus", 40);
  if (!(status in STATUS_LABELS)) {
    throw validationError("O status atual esperado é inválido.", { field: "expectedCurrentStatus" });
  }
  if (requireBoolean(input.confirmation, "confirmation") !== true) {
    throw validationError("Confirme a conclusão do reparo.", { field: "confirmation" });
  }

  const hasTechnicianUserId = input.technicianUserId !== undefined;
  const hasLegacyTechnician = input.technicianResponsible !== undefined;
  if (hasTechnicianUserId === hasLegacyTechnician) {
    throw validationError(
      "Informe exatamente um técnico responsável.",
      { field: "technicianUserId" },
    );
  }

  return {
    expectedCurrentStatus: status as ReadyCommand["expectedCurrentStatus"],
    confirmation: true,
    ...(hasTechnicianUserId
      ? {
          technicianUserId: requireNonEmptyString(
            input.technicianUserId,
            "technicianUserId",
            STOCK_TEXT_LIMITS.ID,
          ),
        }
      : {
          technicianResponsible: requireNonEmptyString(
            input.technicianResponsible,
            "technicianResponsible",
            120,
          ),
        }),
  };
}

function stableScope(value: string): string {
  return createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex").slice(0, 32);
}

function operatorScope(context: InternalCommandContext): string {
  return context.operatorId ? `user_${stableScope(context.operatorId)}` : "system";
}

function commandLogicalKey(
  orderId: string,
  context: InternalCommandContext,
): string {
  return buildPersistedIdempotencyKey({
    namespace: "so",
    operation: "consume-ready",
    version: "v1",
    resources: [operatorScope(context), stableScope(orderId)],
    requestKey: context.idempotencyKey,
  });
}

function movementKey(
  orderId: string,
  itemId: string,
  context: InternalCommandContext,
  payloadHash: string,
): string {
  return `${buildPersistedIdempotencyKey({
    namespace: "sop",
    operation: "consume",
    version: "v1",
    resources: [operatorScope(context), stableScope(orderId), stableScope(itemId)],
    requestKey: context.idempotencyKey,
  })}:${payloadHash}`;
}

function movementCommandPattern(
  orderId: string,
  context: InternalCommandContext,
  payloadHash: string,
): string {
  const escapeLike = (value: string) =>
    value.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/%/g, "\\%").replace(/_/g, "\\_");
  // Movimento: sop:consume:v1:{operator}:{order}:{item}:{requestKey}:{hash}.
  // O item varia entre os movimentos do mesmo comando; a chave externa e o
  // hash permanecem fixos e são delimitados para não aceitar outro comando.
  const commandPrefix = [
    "sop",
    "consume",
    "v1",
    operatorScope(context),
    stableScope(orderId),
  ].join(":");
  return `${escapeLike(commandPrefix)}:%:${escapeLike(context.idempotencyKey)}:${escapeLike(payloadHash)}`;
}

function requireOrder(database: StockDatabase, id: string): TechnicalServiceOrderRecord {
  const order = findTechnicalServiceOrder(database, id);
  if (!order) throw stockError("SERVICE_ORDER_NOT_FOUND", 404, "A ordem de serviço não foi encontrada.");
  return order;
}

function project(
  order: TechnicalServiceOrderRecord,
  items: ServiceOrderPartRecord[],
  movements: TechnicalPartMovementRecord[],
  context: InternalCommandContext,
  replay: boolean,
): ConsumeReadyResult {
  return {
    order: {
      id: order.id,
      status: order.status,
      technicianResponsible: order.technicianResponsible,
      technicianUserId: order.technicianUserId,
      ...(context.canViewFinancialData
        ? { technicianProfitPercentSnapshot: order.technicianProfitPercentSnapshot }
        : {}),
      partsCost: order.partsCost,
      laborCost: order.laborCost,
      discount: order.discount,
      totalAmount: order.totalAmount,
    },
    consumedItems: items.map((item) => sanitizeServiceOrderPart(item, context.canViewFinancialData)),
    movements: movements.map((movement) => sanitizeTechnicalPartMovement(movement, context.canViewFinancialData)),
    affectedItems: items.length,
    affectedUnits: items.reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0),
    idempotentReplay: replay,
  };
}

function invariant(message: string): never {
  throw stockError("STOCK_INVARIANT_VIOLATION", 409, message);
}

function validatePair(item: ServiceOrderPartRecord, part: TechnicalPartRecord | null): TechnicalPartRecord {
  if (!part) throw stockError("TECHNICAL_PART_NOT_FOUND", 404, "A peça técnica não foi encontrada.");
  if (item.technicalPartId !== part.id) invariant("O vínculo do item técnico está inconsistente.");
  try {
    requirePositiveInteger(item.quantity, "quantity");
  } catch {
    invariant("A quantidade do item técnico está inconsistente.");
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(part.version) || part.version >= STOCK_NUMERIC_LIMITS.MAX_VERSION) {
    invariant("A versão da peça técnica está inconsistente.");
  }
  if (part.quantityReserved < item.quantity) invariant("O saldo reservado está inconsistente.");
  if (part.quantityOnHand !== null && part.quantityOnHand < item.quantity) {
    invariant("O saldo físico está inconsistente.");
  }
  return part;
}

function makeServices(write: WriteRunner, failAfter?: FailurePoint) {
  function markServiceOrderReadyAndConsumeTechnicalParts(
    serviceOrderIdValue: unknown,
    inputValue: unknown,

  ): ConsumeReadyResult {
    const serviceOrderId = requireNonEmptyString(serviceOrderIdValue, "serviceOrderId", STOCK_TEXT_LIMITS.ID);

    const context = validateCommandContext(contextValue);
    const logicalKey = commandLogicalKey(serviceOrderId, context);
    const payloadHash = hashIdempotentPayload(input);

    return write("service-order-ready-consume", (database) => {
      const priorCommand = findServiceOrderTechnicalCommand(database, logicalKey);
      if (priorCommand) {
        if (
          priorCommand.operation !== "CONSUME_ON_READY" ||
          priorCommand.serviceOrderId !== serviceOrderId ||
          priorCommand.payloadHash !== payloadHash
        ) {
          throw stockError("IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED", 409, "A chave de idempotência já foi usada com dados diferentes.");
        }
        const replayMovements = listConsumptionMovementsForCommand(database, {
          serviceOrderId,
          movementPattern: movementCommandPattern(serviceOrderId, context, payloadHash),
        });
        const replayItems: ServiceOrderPartRecord[] = [];
        const itemIds = new Set<string>();
        for (const movement of replayMovements) {
          if (!movement.serviceOrderPartId || itemIds.has(movement.serviceOrderPartId)) {
            invariant("O histórico do consumo técnico está inconsistente.");
          }
          const item = findOrderPartById(database, movement.serviceOrderPartId);
          if (!item || item.serviceOrderId !== serviceOrderId) {
            invariant("O vínculo do consumo técnico está inconsistente.");
          }
          if (item.state !== "CONSUMED" && item.state !== "REVERSED") {
            invariant("O estado atual do item técnico está inconsistente.");
          }
          if (
            movement.type !== "CONSUMPTION" ||
            movement.technicalPartId !== item.technicalPartId ||
            movement.quantity !== item.quantity ||
            movement.idempotencyKey !== movementKey(serviceOrderId, item.id, context, payloadHash)
          ) {
            invariant("O histórico do consumo técnico está inconsistente.");
          }
          if (countConsumptionMovementsForItem(database, item.id) !== 1) {
            invariant("Existem múltiplos movimentos de consumo para o item técnico.");
          }
          itemIds.add(item.id);
          replayItems.push(item);

        if (replayItems.length !== priorCommand.affectedItems) {
          invariant("A auditoria do consumo técnico está inconsistente.");
        }
        return project(requireOrder(database, serviceOrderId), replayItems, replayMovements, context, true);
      }

      const order = requireOrder(database, serviceOrderId);
      if (order.status !== input.expectedCurrentStatus) {
        throw stockError("ORDER_STATUS_CONFLICT", 409, "A ordem de serviço foi alterada por outra operação.");
      }
      if (order.hasFinalization || order.finalizedAt !== null) {
        throw stockError("ORDER_NOT_MUTABLE", 409, "Esta ordem de serviço não pode ser marcada como pronta.");
      }



      let technicianResponsible: string;
      let technicianUserId: string | null = null;
      let technicianProfitPercentSnapshot: number | null = null;

      if (input.technicianUserId) {
        const technician = findActiveTechnicianForReady(database, input.technicianUserId);
        if (!technician) {
          throw validationError(
            "Selecione um técnico ativo cadastrado no sistema.",
            { field: "technicianUserId" },
          );
        }
        if (!technician.name.trim()) {
          invariant("O cadastro do técnico está inconsistente.");
        }
        if (
          !Number.isFinite(technician.profitSharePercent) ||
          technician.profitSharePercent < 0 ||
          technician.profitSharePercent > 100
        ) {
          invariant("O percentual de participação do técnico está inconsistente.");
        }

        technicianResponsible = technician.name.trim();
        technicianUserId = technician.id;
        technicianProfitPercentSnapshot = technician.profitShareEnabled
          ? Math.round((technician.profitSharePercent + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100
          : 0;
      } else {
        technicianResponsible = input.technicianResponsible!;
      }

      const items = listReservedOrderParts(database, serviceOrderId);
      const pairs = items.map((item) => {
        if (findConsumptionMovementForItem(database, item.id)) {
          invariant("O item técnico já possui consumo registrado.");
        }
        return { item, part: validatePair(item, findTechnicalPartById(database, item.technicalPartId)) };
      });

      const movements: TechnicalPartMovementRecord[] = [];
      for (let index = 0; index < pairs.length; index += 1) {
        const { item, part } = pairs[index];
        if (consumeTechnicalPartReservation(database, {
          id: part.id,
          version: part.version,
          quantity: item.quantity,
          unlimited: part.quantityOnHand === null,
        }) !== 1) invariant("Não foi possível consumir o saldo técnico.");
        if (index === 0 && failAfter === "after_first_part") throw new Error("laboratory failure");

        if (consumeReservedOrderPart(database, {
          id: item.id,
          serviceOrderId,
          technicalPartId: part.id,
          quantity: item.quantity,
        }) !== 1) invariant("Não foi possível consumir o item técnico.");
        if (index === 0 && failAfter === "after_first_item") throw new Error("laboratory failure");

        const after = findTechnicalPartById(database, part.id)!;
        assertTechnicalMovementInvariant({
          type: "CONSUMPTION",
          quantity: item.quantity,
          onHandBefore: part.quantityOnHand,
          onHandAfter: after.quantityOnHand,
          reservedBefore: part.quantityReserved,
          reservedAfter: after.quantityReserved,
        });
        const movement = insertTechnicalPartMovement(database, {
          technicalPartId: part.id,
          serviceOrderPartId: item.id,
          type: "CONSUMPTION",
          quantity: item.quantity,
          onHandBefore: part.quantityOnHand,
          onHandAfter: after.quantityOnHand,
          reservedBefore: part.quantityReserved,
          reservedAfter: after.quantityReserved,
          unitCostSnapshot: item.unitCostSnapshot,
          reason: "Consumo ao concluir reparo da ordem de serviço",
          operatorId: context.operatorId,

  exigirPermissaoApi,

export const dynamic = "force-dynamic";

type RouteContext = {
  params: Promise<{
    id: string;
  }>;
};

type UsuarioSessao = NonNullable<Parameters<typeof usuarioTemPermissao>[0]>;

const statusPermitidos: OrderStatus[] = [
  OrderStatus.RECEBIDO,
  OrderStatus.EM_ANALISE,
  OrderStatus.AGUARDANDO_PECA,
  OrderStatus.EM_REPARO,
  OrderStatus.PRONTO,
];

const nomesStatus: Record<string, string> = {
  RECEBIDO: "Recebido",
  EM_ANALISE: "Em análise",
  AGUARDANDO_PECA: "Aguardando peça",
  EM_REPARO: "Em reparo",
  PRONTO: "Pronto",
  ENTREGUE: "Entregue",
  CANCELADO: "Cancelado",
};

function nomeOperador(usuario: UsuarioSessao | null | undefined) {
  return usuario?.name?.trim() || usuario?.username?.trim() || "Sistema";
}

function textoLimitado(valor: unknown, limite: number) {
  return String(valor || "")
    .trim()
    .slice(0, limite);
}

function podeVerDadosPagamento(usuario: UsuarioSessao | null | undefined) {
  if (!usuario) return false;

  return usuarioTemPermissao(usuario, [
    "pagamentos.ver",
    "pagamentos.registrar",
    "relatorios.financeiro",
  ]);
}

function sanitizarOrdemStatus(
  ordem: any,
  mostrarPagamentos: boolean,
  mostrarFinanceiroSensivel: boolean,
) {
  const base = mostrarPagamentos
    ? ordem
    : {
        ...ordem,
        paidAmount: null,
        paymentPercent: null,
        paymentReceivedAt: null,
        paymentMethod: null,
        payments: [],
        finalization: ordem.finalization
          ? {
              ...ordem.finalization,
              finalAmount: null,
              paymentMethod: null,
            }
          : null,
      };

  if (mostrarFinanceiroSensivel) return base;

  return {
    ...base,
    technicianProfitPercentSnapshot: null,
  };
}

function respostaErroEstoque(error: unknown) {
  const mapped = toFutureHttpError(error);
  const headers: Record<string, string> = { "Cache-Control": "no-store" };
  if (mapped.body.retryable) headers["Retry-After"] = "1";
  return NextResponse.json(mapped.body, { status: mapped.status, headers });

  const permitidos = new Set([
    "status",
    "expectedCurrentStatus",
    "confirmation",
    "technicianResponsible",
  ]);

    return "O payload contém campos não permitidos para concluir a OS.";

  if (body.status !== OrderStatus.PRONTO) return "O status de destino deve ser PRONTO.";

    OrderStatus.RECEBIDO,
    OrderStatus.EM_ANALISE,
    OrderStatus.AGUARDANDO_PECA,
    OrderStatus.EM_REPARO,
  ];
  if (
    typeof body.expectedCurrentStatus !== "string" ||
    !statusesOrigem.includes(body.expectedCurrentStatus)
  ) {
    return "Informe o status atual esperado da OS.";
  }
  if (body.confirmation !== true) return "Confirme a conclusão do reparo.";
  if (
    typeof body.technicianResponsible !== "string" ||
    !body.technicianResponsible.trim() ||
    body.technicianResponsible.trim().length > 120
  ) {
    return "Informe o técnico responsável pelo serviço.";
  }
  return null;
}

export async function PATCH(request: Request, context: RouteContext) {
  try {
    const body = (await request.json().catch(() => null)) as Record<
      string,
      unknown
    > | null;

      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Dados inválidos para alterar status." },
        { status: 400 }
      );

    const statusSolicitado = String(body.status || "").trim().toUpperCase();

      statusSolicitado === OrderStatus.PRONTO
        ? "ordens.marcar_pronto"
        : "ordens.alterar_status";

    const acesso = await exigirPermissaoApi(permissaoStatus);

    if (!acesso.ok) return acesso.response;

    const { id } = await context.params;
    const novoStatus = statusSolicitado as OrderStatus;
    const userName = nomeOperador(acesso.usuario);
    const technicianResponsible = textoLimitado(body.technicianResponsible, 120);

    if (statusSolicitado === OrderStatus.PRONTO) {
      if (!String(request.headers.get("content-type") || "").toLowerCase().startsWith("application/json")) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: "Content-Type application/json é obrigatório." },
          { status: 422, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
        );
      }
      const payloadError = validarComandoPronto(body);
      if (payloadError) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          { code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message: payloadError },
          { status: 422, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
        );
      }
      let idempotencyKey: string;
      try {
        idempotencyKey = requireIdempotencyKey(request.headers.get("Idempotency-Key"));
      } catch (error) {
        const mapped = toFutureHttpError(error);
        return NextResponse.json(
          { ...mapped.body, code: mapped.body.code },
          { status: 422, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" } },
        );
      }
      try {
        const result = markServiceOrderReadyAndConsumeTechnicalParts(
          id,
          {
            expectedCurrentStatus: body.expectedCurrentStatus,
            confirmation: true,
            technicianResponsible: String(body.technicianResponsible).trim(),
          },
          {
            operatorId: acesso.usuario.id || null,
            operatorName: userName,
            canViewFinancialData: usuarioPodeVerDadosFinanceirosSensiveis(acesso.usuario),
            idempotencyKey,
          },
        );

        // Leitura complementar somente após o commit para manter o contrato
        // histórico da rota; falhas aqui não desfazem o consumo confirmado.
        try {
          const ordemCompleta = await prisma.serviceOrder.findUnique({
            where: { id },
            include: {
              customer: true,
              histories: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
              finalization: true,
              attachments: true,
              payments: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
            },
          });
          if (ordemCompleta) {
            return NextResponse.json(
              sanitizarOrdemStatus(
                ordemCompleta,
                podeVerDadosPagamento(acesso.usuario),
                usuarioPodeVerDadosFinanceirosSensiveis(acesso.usuario),
              ),
            );
          }
        } catch {
          // O commit já ocorreu; retornar o resumo seguro abaixo.
        }
        return NextResponse.json({
          ...result,
          reloadOrder: true,
        });
      } catch (error) {
        return respostaErroEstoque(error);
      }
    }

    if (!statusPermitidos.includes(novoStatus)) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message:
            "Status inválido para alteração rápida. Para cancelar, use a tela de cancelamento. Para entregar, use a finalização.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    if (novoStatus === OrderStatus.PRONTO && !technicianResponsible) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message:
            "Informe o técnico responsável pelo serviço antes de marcar a OS como pronta.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const ordemExistente = await prisma.serviceOrder.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: { finalization: true },
    });

    if (!ordemExistente) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { message: "Ordem não encontrada." },
        { status: 404 }
      );
    }

    if (ordemExistente.status === OrderStatus.CANCELADO) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          message:
            "Não é possível alterar status de uma OS cancelada. Reabra a OS primeiro.",
        },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

      ordemExistente.status === OrderStatus.ENTREGUE ||
      ordemExistente.finalization
    ) {

        {
          message:

        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

        { message: "Escolha um status diferente do atual." },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

      novoStatus === OrderStatus.PRONTO

            nomesStatus[statusAnterior] || statusAnterior
          } para ${
            nomesStatus[novoStatus] || novoStatus
          }. Técnico responsável pelo serviço: ${technicianResponsible}.`
        : `Status alterado de ${
            nomesStatus[statusAnterior] || statusAnterior
          } para ${nomesStatus[novoStatus] || novoStatus}.`;

    const ordemAtualizada = await prisma.serviceOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: novoStatus,
        ...(novoStatus === OrderStatus.PRONTO
          ? { technicianResponsible }
          : {}),
        histories: {
          create: {
            userName,
            action: "ALTERACAO_STATUS",
            description: descriptionStatus,
          },
        },
      },
      include: {
        customer: true,
        histories: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
        finalization: true,
        attachments: true,
        payments: { orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" } },
      },
    });

    return NextResponse.json(
      sanitizarOrdemStatus(
        ordemAtualizada,
        podeVerDadosPagamento(acesso.usuario),
        usuarioPodeVerDadosFinanceirosSensiveis(acesso.usuario),
      )
    );
  } catch {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { message: "Erro ao alterar status da OS." },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}
